name: Browse the redesigned portfolio and filter selected work
description: Verifies visitors can navigate the new portfolio, inspect services and filter selected work.
steps: Open the portfolio homepage
Navigate to Services and Selected Work
Choose the AI filter and then All
Open the same sections at a mobile viewport
expected: The redesigned sections remain readable, project filters update the cards, and the mobile layout keeps navigation and cards usable.

name: Configure an estimate and carry it into the inquiry
description: Verifies estimate choices update the NGN range and the selected estimate can be transferred to the contact inquiry.
steps: Open Project Planner
Select Full-stack application and Advanced complexity
Return to Business website and change the page count
Choose Discuss this estimate
Inspect the project details field in Contact
expected: The NGN range updates with service, complexity and page count, and the selected service, complexity and range appear in the contact details.

name: Owner manages showcase projects with authorization
description: Verifies the authorized owner can publish and manage showcase projects while public visitors only browse.
steps: Open the owner sign-in from the Selected Work section
Sign in with the authorized owner account
Publish a project with a valid URL and tags
Feature the project and refresh the showcase
Remove the test project
expected: Only the allowlisted owner can write to the showcase; published changes appear publicly and removal persists.

name: Validate inquiry fields and FAQ interaction on mobile
covers: AI chatbot panel and message submission
description: Verifies mobile visitors can navigate, expand answers and submit only a valid inquiry form.
steps: Open the mobile navigation and visit the FAQ section
Use the floating WhatsApp button and verify it opens a WhatsApp chat with the configured number
Open the Ask AI button and confirm the chatbot panel appears
Ask what services James Digitals offers and verify a business-specific reply appears
Expand and collapse an FAQ answer
Submit the contact form with required fields empty
Enter valid name and email and complete the project details
expected: The WhatsApp shortcut opens a chat for +2348153126056; navigation and FAQ controls work on mobile, invalid required fields are blocked, and a valid inquiry opens the user's email app with details prefilled.
